title: Keep Chapter 5 durable by presenting AI technologies as illustrative
requirements:
- Lead with durable principles; present skills, agents and MCP as illustrative examples
- Reduce emphasis on fast-changing AI terminology and move it to a maintained online annex
- Reframe beyond AI readiness and outline a minimum metadata profile
- Either rename/clarify the chapter's AI emphasis or treat other technologies substantively
- Identify a small mandatory provenance set as robust regardless of AI progress
- Move time-sensitive assertions (e.g. on LLM use in claims) out of stable guidance
- Group the listed technologies by architectural role
